game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Search Scout: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: In Eldritch Heart, repeat each round: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list. Each round, rune wisps strike the crypt seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the found value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from rune wisps in Eldritch Heart: keep the found meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: found drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Search Scout
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Search Scout' (Week 7 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how found changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Eldritch Heart.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while found > 0.
